hooks.command: input=$(cat); cmd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -q 'deploy.sh'; then last_test=$(find quality/tests -name '*.py' -newer custom_components/universal_room_automation/const.py 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -z "$last_test" ]; then echo 'WARNING: Tests may not have been run since last code change' >&2; fi; fi; exit 0

jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' | grep -q 'git commit' && printf '{"systemMessage":"VibeMemo: Before committing, check for uncaptured decisions. Run /vibememo-eval (Part 1 capture + narrative update). Also synthesize user narratives into project narrative — commits are a consistency checkpoint."}' || printf '{}'

printf '{"systemMessage":"VibeMemo session-end: Run /vibememo-eval (Part 1 + Part 2) before closing. Capture uncaptured decisions, score all 9 eval dimensions, and synthesize user narratives into project narrative."}'
